note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; all three castes are described; the unit of the cuticular rod diameter on the wing membrane is incomplete in the scan; the synonymy list, figure numbers, locality, distribution records and taxonomic discussion are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Alate total length 32.0–34.0 with wings, 14.0–15.5 without wings, head capsule distinctly wider than long, antennae 19-segmented; soldier total length 4.6–6.70, head capsule subrectangular, mandibles long with the anterior part rather strongly incurved; workers dimorphic, major worker total length 4.0–5.5. Head and body densely or rather densely hairy in all castes.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow to yellowish brown, antennae light brown apically and paler at base, mandibles dark brown, body and legs white to pale yellow; head sparsely hairy, body densely hairy; total length 4.6–6.70. Head capsule subrectangular with an oval outline, sides weakly convex (length to base of mandibles 1.50–1.90, maximum width 1.30–1.50, width at base of mandibles 0.88–1.03, maximum width/length 0.70–0.87, width at base of mandibles/maximum width 0.65–0.73). Antennae 16–17-segmented, with 16 segments segment 4 shortest, with 17 segments segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus without a distinct boundary with the frons, only faint traces at the sides, with a few hairs. Labrum broadly lingulate, anterior margin broadly rounded (0.35–0.48 long, 0.40–0.43 wide). Mandibles long, anterior part rather strongly incurved, about two-thirds of head length (1.03–1.20 long, left mandible length/head length 0.62–0.71); left mandible with one prominent tooth slightly above the middle, tooth distance 0.43–0.53, tooth distance/mandible length 0.41–0.46; right mandible with one small tooth at the middle, tooth distance 0.50–0.58. Postmentum subrectangular, flat, widest at the anterior quarter, sides weakly incurved behind it (0.95–1.18 long, 0.53–0.65 maximum width). Pronotum saddle-shaped (0.53–0.75 long, 0.95–1.20 wide), anterior and posterior margins both deeply concave; mesonotum narrower than pronotum; metanotum as wide as or wider than pronotum.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Dimorphic. Major worker: head capsule light yellowish brown, antennae light brown, paler at base, body and legs pale yellow; head and body rather densely hairy; total length 4.0–5.5. Head capsule subcircular, wider than long (length to base of mandibles 1.20–1.38, maximum width 1.40–1.63). Antennae 17–18-segmented, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus raised, hairy, less than half as long as wide (0.33 long, 0.80 wide). Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin deeply concave, posterior margin weakly to deeply concave (0.45–0.55 long, 0.80–0.90 wide). Minor worker: similar to major worker but smaller, postclypeus relatively more raised, antennae 17-segmented; total length 3.2–3.8, length to base of mandibles 0.73–0.88, maximum head width 0.90–1.05, postclypeus 0.25 long and 0.50 wide, pronotum 0.33–0.45 long, 0.55–0.68 wide.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head capsule brown to dark reddish brown, paler around fontanelle; in front of the fontanelle a small circular spot, 2 pale small spots between the ocelli and 1 on each side above the ocelli; postclypeus and labrum yellowish brown, antennae brown; pronotum brown, with a paler T-shaped median mark and shoulder spots; abdominal tergites brown to dark brown, sternites and legs yellowish brown; head and body densely hairy. Total length 32.0–34.0 with wings, 14.0–15.5 without wings. Head capsule subcircular, distinctly wider than long (length to base of mandibles 1.80–2.13, width including eyes 2.5–3.08). Fontanelle very small, circular, slightly raised. Eyes large, broadly oval (maximum diameter 0.73–0.95, minimum diameter 0.65–0.90), equidistant from the lower margin of the head and from the antennae. Ocelli broadly oval (long diameter 0.33–0.40, short diameter 0.20–0.30), separated from the eye by about half their short diameter (0.10–0.15). Antennae 19-segmented, segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus strongly raised, slightly less than half as long as wide (0.55–0.58 long, 1.20–1.25 wide). Pronotum nearly trapezoidal (1.20–1.40 long, 2.10–2.75 wide), posterior margin slightly to distinctly incurved at middle. Forewing 28.0–29.3 long, hindwing 26.5–27.5 long, wing membrane with fine wavy cuticular rods 8–13 μm in diameter.
